name: io.github.nouchix/pqc-khepra-mcp
title: PQC-Khepra MCP — CMMC Autopilot & AI Security Recorder
description: Post-quantum CMMC compliance scanner & AI agent attestation. FIPS 140-3, ML-DSA-65, 36K+ mappings.

environmentVariables.name: KHEPRA_LICENSE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: License key for AdinKhepra ASAF paid tiers. Leave empty for community mode.

environmentVariables.name: SUPABASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Supabase project URL — required for SouHimBou AI Flight Recorder integration.

environmentVariables.name: SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Supabase anon key for Flight Recorder integration.

tools.name: ert_scan
tools.description: Enterprise Risk & Threat (ERT) scan. Runs full STIG/CMMC/NIST 800-171 compliance scan and returns prioritized findings with dollar-denominated risk scores.

tools.name: stig_check
tools.description: Validate a system path or configuration file against RHEL-09-STIG controls. Returns pass/fail per control with remediation steps.

tools.name: nist_map
tools.description: Map CCI identifiers or STIG findings to NIST 800-53 Rev 5 controls. Uses 36,195 pre-computed cross-framework mappings (STIG → CCI → NIST → CMMC).

tools.name: cmmc_assess
tools.description: Assess a system or artifact against CMMC Level 1, 2, or 3 practices. Returns a scored maturity report per practice domain.

tools.name: godfather_report
tools.description: Generate a Godfather Report — an executive-facing, dollar-denominated cyber risk report from prior scan results. Suitable for C-suite and board briefings.

tools.name: attest_export
tools.description: Export a PQC-signed (ML-DSA-65 / NIST FIPS 204) attestation package accepted by C3PAO intake, cyber insurance carriers, and RFP submissions.

tools.name: agent_record
tools.description: Send AI agent tool calls and outputs to the SouHimBou AI Flight Recorder for tamper-evident capture with DAG-anchored PQC attestation.

tools.name: scan_shadow_ai
tools.description: Discover unapproved AI services, agents, LLMs, and vector DBs across target CIDRs.

tools.name: attest_ai_policy
tools.description: Evaluate discovered AI findings against governance policy, returning verdicts and postures.

tools.name: linux_hardening_check
tools.description: Run real-time Linux host hardening checks against Trimstray Practical Hardening & DISA RHEL rules.

tools.name: stig_live_query
tools.description: Query the live DISA STIG Viewer API v2 for updated benchmarks, CCIs, and fix texts.
